info.title: Automancer public data API
info.summary: Read-only, key-free JSON facts about Automancer Ltd and its published work.
info.description:
Static JSON endpoints describing Automancer Ltd, a UK AI & workflow automation consultancy: business facts, services with published from-prices, case studies, field notes and a full page inventory.

Everything here is PUBLIC DATA requiring no authentication, no API key and no payment. The API is strictly READ-ONLY: only GET exists; there are no write operations, user accounts or tracking. All responses are generated at build time and change only at deploy, so they cache well.

Human-readable documentation: https://automancer.uk/developers — start there, or at https://automancer.uk/api/index.json for machine discovery.

Versioning and deprecation: this is version 1 of the API. A breaking change is published at a new versioned path (/api/v2/<name>.json) while the old path keeps its shape; a removal is announced in https://automancer.uk/api/stability.json `deprecations` at least 90 days before its sunset date. New fields and endpoints may be added at any deploy.

priceUnit.description: What the from-price buys one unit of.

slug.description: URL slug — the same id used by /work/<slug>.

title.description: The case study's name, as on its /work card and in its page <title>.

headline.description: The editorial heading shown as the case study page's h1.

status.description: Delivery status as published (e.g. "Live in production").

stats.description: Headline numbers quoted in the case study.

body.description: Full body text as raw Markdown.

id.description: Stable claim id in the Automancer BD truth-layer registry.

sourceQuote.description: Evidence quote recorded by the truth layer.

topics.description: Subjects available in the Field Notes index, most notes first. General notes appear in fieldNotes only.

label.description: Subject shown on the site. Matches fieldNotes[].category.

slug.description: URL slug of the subject filter.

count.description: Number of published notes on this subject.

url.description: Field Notes page with this subject selected in the browser.

slug.description: URL slug — the same id used by /field-notes/<slug>.

category.description: Editorial category; falls back to sector when uncategorised.

body.description: Full body text as raw Markdown.

procedure: A broken shape is published at a NEW versioned path (/api/v2/<name>.json) and advertised here and in /api/index.json. The existing path keeps serving its current shape; it is not rewritten in place.
The old path, or the narrower field, is added to `deprecations` below with the date it was announced, the date it stops being served, and the replacement to use.
The old path is removed only after its `sunset` date has passed, and never sooner than `minimumNoticeDays` after it appeared in this list.

x-markdown-twins.description: Every HTML content page is also available as clean Markdown at its own path plus ".md" (e.g. /about.md), served as text/markdown with YAML front matter.
